title: Nuh 71:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Nuh 71:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 36. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ (١) قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ (٢) أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ (٣) يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ (٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
[Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

keywords.def: fear Him, be mindful of Him

questions.q: Chunk and link Nuh 71:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 71:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 71:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the two waqf signs in 71:4 and say what each allows.
questions.a: ۚ after «مُّسَمًّى»: equal; ۖ after «لَا يُؤَخَّرُ»: continuing is better.

questions.q: 71:4 promises a delay 'to a specified term'. What is the term that cannot be delayed?
questions.a: The appointed time of Allah: death and the punishment He decreed.

questions.q: What three things did Nuh call his people to (71:3)?
options: Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me
Build a ship, travel and trade
questions.a: A) Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me. 71:3.

questions.q: Nuh 71:2: «قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Nuh (peace be upon him) called his people for 950 years. What does that tell you about patience in calling others to good?
questions.a: Keep going kindly and steadily; results are with Allah, our duty is to convey the message well.
